messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server error
parts:
You never enter in shinyUI/shinyServer calls directly at the console (and you never source ui.R and server.R files). Instead you point Shiny at them by calling runApp() and passing in the directory where these files live. They need to be executed at particular times in the web application lifecycle so it's not something you can do from the console.

See http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#run-and-debug

In this particular example you can run:

shiny::runGist("https://gist.github.com/wch/4034323")

which is equivalent to downloading those files to a temp directory and calling shiny::runApp() on it.
